# src/components/ui/pickers/ (shared record pickers)

`ContactPicker` (customers | suppliers), `AccountPicker` (GL accounts), `ItemPicker`, `VatCodePicker` - labelled,
searchable, keyboard-navigable single-selects built on `Select`. Import from `@/components/ui`.

**`ContactPicker` is the kit standard for choosing a customer or supplier.** `SupplierSelect`
(`components/accounting/supplier-invoices/`) and `CustomerTypeahead` (`customer-invoices/`) are the older, narrower
copies; they migrate onto it in W1 and are not deleted before that. Do not add a third.

## Caller contract
- `label` is required (it is the accessible name; the search box is `Search <label>`). `labelClassName` matches a form's own label style.
- `onChange(value, option)`. A record outside the loaded page is named by `valueLabel`, or, when that is absent, by an
  id lookup (`ContactPicker`: `?id=`, active or not; `AccountPicker`: the chart). A lookup that fails shows under the field at once.
- `AccountPicker` also takes `valueKey="code"` (value = account code, for code-keyed reports), `accountType`,
  `accountSubtype`, and `refine(rows)`, which sees the WHOLE chart before the type filters.
- `onCreateNew(query)` adds a trailing `+ Create new <noun> "<query>"` row. The picker never creates anything.
  `VatCodePicker` has none.

## Rules
- Lazy: nothing is fetched until the dropdown opens; every open refetches (`AccountPicker`: unless its chart is under
  30 s old). Typing is debounced (250 ms); a newer request cancels the older one and a superseded response is dropped
  (`useRemoteOptions`). The hook is `loading` from the start and again when closed, so the opening render says "Loading".
- Page size: opening shows at most 20 rows, a typed query 50; a full page carries a "Showing the first N" hint.
  Contacts are active only. Never open by loading a whole directory.
- A failed load shows an alert INSTEAD of the list (never an empty list) and offers no create row. `apiFetch`
  resolves on 4xx/5xx, so every request goes through `apiJson` (`pickerData.ts`), which throws.
- The chart-of-accounts route has no `q`: `AccountPicker` reads the whole chart and filters locally. That one request
  takes no AbortSignal (shared between the name lookup and typeahead; aborting it for one fails the other).
- `VatCodePicker` is a static `Select` over `RuleVatCode` (labels keyed by it, so a new code fails to compile until
  labelled; rate from `SA_VAT_RATE_PCT`): no request, no debounce, no loading, no create row. **Items use `'zero'`,
  not `'zero_rated'`: do not use it on the items form until the vocabularies are unified.**
- `Select` additions these rely on (all optional): `onSearch`, `onOpenChange`, `loading`, `loadError`, `onCreateNew`,
  `valueOption`, `emptyText`, `hint`, `labelClassName`. Keep the combobox ARIA contract: `aria-controls` -> a listbox
  that exists in every state.

Tests: `tests/unit/components/uiPickers.test.tsx`, `uiPickersLists.test.tsx`, `uiPickersVatCode.test.tsx`,
`useRemoteOptions.test.tsx`, `uiSelectAdditions.test.tsx` (fixtures: `tests/unit/helpers/pickerFixtures.ts`).
